answer: Ephemeral Challenge Lattice. Each identity must answer a fresh, agent-specific challenge whose solution is a mirror of its private state, so copying another agent’s reply fails. Correct answers unlock a temporary island of rate-limited API access; wrong or reused answers reset progress. The system sets a zenith cap on cumulative idle capacity, forcing attackers to solve every challenge live. Cost: sustained compute plus latency per identity, making mass sybils economically unviable.
